title: POLY PMNA Android app 3.0
message: The native app and sidebar match the current POLY PMNA website, including Revision 2026.
releaseNotes: Revision 2026 and Revision 2021 are separate native drawer destinations.
Revision 2026 lessons and notes use dedicated content folders.
Ask POLY AI uses the current whole-site revision-aware knowledge system.
Mock Exams, Tools, Question Papers, 2015 Materials, About and Help remain available.
